what: Every model request of the dsh-driver smoke scenarios (runtime.smoke.test.mjs), recorded with DSH_DIRECTOR_RECORD_DIR before the dsh-director split (commit 9dc85a7886, the unsplit runtime plus the test-only recorder) and after it, on the same host state.

files.smoke-requests.json.gz: {scratch, boots: [boot1, boot2, boot3]}; each request is {options, summary, child, host} as the fixture provider received it
files.bridge-completions.json.gz: {scratch, completions, activity}: the bodies the default host adapter sent to the backend /completion bridge (route, reasoning_effort, tools, messages)

recorded_normalization.uuid: every 8-4-4-4-12 hex UUID (message ids, child session ids, goal ids) is replaced by <UUID> before storing
recorded_normalization.scratch: the run's temporary directory is replaced by <SCRATCH>
recorded_normalization.signal: options.signal (an AbortSignal, serialised as {}) is dropped

compare_normalization.ignored_keys_why: none. compaction_seq was listed here; on the committed before/after pair it never differs (emptying the list keeps the comparison green), so the exclusion was unused and is removed. Its run-to-run noise was observed only in uncommitted runs, which this file no longer cites.
compare_normalization.streams: requests are compared per boot and per kind (R root, C child, S summary) in order; interleaving between kinds is scheduling, not content.
compare_normalization.prefix: every stream of boots 1 and 2 must have the same length before and after, except the streams listed in allowed_length_differences, each with its exact two lengths; such a stream is compared over its common prefix and the unmatched last request is NOT compared.
compare_normalization.boot3: the third boot is compared on its first root request's provider, model, tools and system message only. Its messages differ by a whole model-visible message, not by order: the committed 'before' has 12 messages, including a subagent-settled notice from the child of the previous boot, and 'after' has 11 without it - whether that notice is persisted before the goal round is a race between the child's settle and the restart. This window is excluded, and named as such.
compare_normalization.what_the_test_proves: boots 1 and 2: every request of every stream is equal, except the unmatched tail of the one listed stream; boot 3: the same system prompt, tools and model; the bridge bodies: all equal.

allowed_length_differences.why: the child's last request was still in flight when the second boot was stopped

reproduce: dsh-director/tools/normalize-recording.mjs applies recorded_normalization to a raw recording; re-record 'after' from any commit at or after the split and 'before' from 9dc85a7886 (see that script).
